question: Find the full names of human superheroes published by Marvel Comics who have more than 10 superpowers and possess the highest strength attribute value among all heroes.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_020
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
JOIN race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND r.XCL_017 = 'Human'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  AND ha.XCL_011 = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.XCL_011)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.XCL_018 IN (
      SELECT hp.XCL_012
      FROM hero_power hp
      GROUP BY hp.XCL_012
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
  )

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009

WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND r.XCL_017 = 'Human'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'

      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Strength'

  AND s.XCL_018 IN (
      SELECT hp.XCL_012
      FROM hero_power hp
      GROUP BY hp.XCL_012
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
